# Empasy SyncSeries — Full Technical & Live Demo Specification for LLMs (llms-full.txt)

> Canonical Source: `https://demo.empasy.io/llms-full.txt`
> Companion Portals: `https://empasy.io` (Corporate & Product Pages) | `https://doc.empasy.com` (Technical Docs) | `https://demo.empasy.io` (Live Demo Portal; `https://sync.empasy.io` redirects here preserving path & query)

## 1. Executive Summary
Empasy SyncSeries is a modular enterprise software suite built on a shared standard foundation (`SyncBoot`) by **Empasy IT Corp. (주식회사 엠파시)**. It comprises 4 flagship solutions (`SyncVerse`, `SyncETA`, `SyncBoot`, `SyncCMS`) and 7 modular extensions sharing a consistent technology stack:
- **Backend**: Java 25, Spring Boot 4.0, Spring Cloud 2025, `AgentScope Java` (`io.agentscope:agentscope-harness`), Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 over SSE.
- **Database & Vector Store**: PostgreSQL 18.6 with `pgvector`, `pg_trgm`, `uuid-ossp`, and Redis 7 cache.
- **Frontend**: Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite (Vben Admin) for enterprise admin consoles; Nuxt 3 SSR for public web (`SyncCMS`); Quasar + Electron + Playwright for desktop QA (`SyncETA`).

## 3. Daily 04:00 KST Reset Policy & SyncETA Desktop Download
1. **Daily Full Reset (`04:00 KST`)**:
   - The `sync-nightly-reset` service runs every day at `04:00 AM KST (Asia/Seoul)`.
   - It resets all demo databases (`sync_boot`, `sync_verse`, `sync_llm`, `sync_insight`, `synccms`, `mall`, `sync_ops`, `sync_crawl`, `synceta_db`, `sync_apim`, `sync_watch`) from the 6-stage SQL seed scripts (`00_extensions.sql` through `05_sample_dev.sql`), flushes Redis, and cleans temporary uploaded demo files.
2. **SyncETA Desktop Application Download**:
   - **Official Download Page (Windows & macOS)**: `https://empasy.io/ko/download_eta.html`
   - **Web Management Console (Demo)**: `https://eta-admin.empasy.io` (resets daily at 04:00 KST).

## 4. Technical Capabilities & Intellectual Property
- **Context-Aware E2E Test Recovery (`SyncETA`)**: Combines Playwright execution, DOM structure context, and visual screen comparison so test suites keep running reliably even when UI layouts change.
- **Controlled Enterprise AI Usage (`SyncLLM`)**: Combines `pgvector` semantic caching, multi-model routing (cloud and on-premise vLLM/Ollama), PII masking, and departmental token budget limits.
- **Patent Portfolio**: Korean Intellectual Property Office (KIPO) patent applications and registrations covering visual UI test recovery, multi-agent approval orchestration, Saga compensation control, and SI dual-rate P&L governance (`https://doc.empasy.com/patents/`).
